verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents its own unauthenticated JSON API over package metadata (formula, cask, per-package and analytics endpoints) that mirrors `brew info --json` output. However, it is a read-only data API: install, upgrade, tap and bundle actions are only available through the CLI, so API parity with the main interface is not achieved. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API coverage of mutating operations (install/upgrade/uninstall/tap), any documented parity guarantee, a formal API description (OpenAPI), versioned endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: List the `brew info --json` output for all current Homebrew/homebrew-core formulae or Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks.
It is a machine-readable data API; no formal API-description artifact (OpenAPI or equivalent) exists
